source.title: Tonic dopamine: opportunity costs and the control of response vigor.

confidence_rationale: Foundational computational account (source_quality 0.85) deriving response VIGOUR (latency/rate of acting) as an optimal-control read-out of a slow modulatory variable -- tonic dopamine reporting the average reward rate / opportunity cost. This is the co-constitutive basal-ganglia partner the AE-9 gate names for MECH-360 (L2): expression INTENSITY is not a separate output channel but a computed consequence of the motivational state driving action selection. mapping_fidelity 0.70 -- it grounds the INTENSITY/vigour dimension of expression-as-action-geometry, but MECH-360's geometry is richer (approach angle, retreat, oscillation, avoidance margin, repair-seeking), only one axis of which is captured by a scalar vigour. exp_conf unchanged 0 -- PROMOTES NOTHING.
failure_signatures: Vigour here is a single scalar (response rate/latency) set by a GLOBAL tonic signal -- it does not differentiate per-candidate (the average reward rate is shared across actions), so it grounds expression INTENSITY but not the per-candidate STYLE differentiation that MECH-360 inherits from MECH-359.

Tonic-DA-as-average-reward is a normative model, not a direct expression measurement; the link from vigour to the visible behavioural geometry (hesitation, approach angle) is an REE-side extrapolation.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Response vigour (the rate/latency of acting) is optimally set by the long-run average reward rate, which acts as the opportunity cost of time and is putatively reported by tonic dopamine levels in nucleus accumbens; higher tonic dopamine -> more vigorous responding. Vigour is a computed consequence of the motivational state, not an independently-engineered output.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-360 asserts expression begins as an EMERGENT read-out of affective arbitration, not a separate output channel. Niv et al supply the cleanest normative instance of that logic in the motor-intensity dimension: the basal-ganglia vigour signal (how fast/hard you act) falls out of the value/motivational landscape rather than being separately specified. This is the 'tonic-DA vigour as expression-intensity partner' the AE-9 readiness gate names -- the BG read-out side of the affect vector.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Vigour in Niv et al is a GLOBAL scalar set by the average reward rate -- it is shared across actions and so does NOT carry the per-candidate differentiation that is MECH-360's distinctive claim. It grounds the expression-INTENSITY axis only; the richer geometry (approach angle, retreat, oscillation, avoidance margin, decommitment, repair-seeking) is not addressed. Also a model, not a direct expression measurement.
mapping.source_context: Average-reward reinforcement-learning / optimal-control model of free-operant behaviour (rodent free-operant data); computational neuroscience.

confidence_components.notes: Strong foundational model but grounds only one axis (intensity) of MECH-360's geometry, and via a global rather than per-candidate signal. Held below the MECH-359 anchors accordingly.
